title: An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA
abstract: arXiv:2611.32114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. translated_title: 一种融合深度学习与解剖学推理的自动化框架，用于从冠脉CT血管造影中进行心脏表型分析
translated_abstract: 冠状动脉计算机断层血管造影能够显示冠状动脉解剖结构和心脏脂肪，但仅靠分割并不能保证解剖学上一致的测量结果。我们提出了一种将深度学习与解剖学推理相结合的自动化框架，用于定量心脏表型分析。其解剖测量模块利用图几何、分支身份以及周围结构来定义血管特异性的冠状动脉周围脂肪组织（PCAT）采样和替代性心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）隔室。后者还可以在无需专家心包轮廓标注的情况下生成训练目标。配套模块可在非增强CT上定量冠状动脉钙化。该框架在五个公开数据集上进行了组件级基准测试：ImageCAS、ImageCAS-X、COCA、Visual Lab和MultiD4CAD。在ImageCAS-X Test-160上，经过验证选择的后处理的管腔分割取得了0.9133的Dice分数和0.940的clDice分数（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种结合深度学习与解剖学推理的自动化框架，实现基于CCTA的定量心脏表型分析，涵盖血管特异性PCAT采样、无需专家标注的EAT测量以及冠状动脉钙化定量。
